reader.requirement: At 1985 (Amendment 1) MEDIAN must order its argument-1 values (each an arithmetic expression, possibly a table with ALL subscripts bounded by the current ODO value) by the numeric simple-condition comparison, i.e. by algebraic value with unsigned operands positive and -0 equal to +0, regardless of usage, scale or literal length.

edition-consulted.switches: IntrinsicFunctionNotYetIntroduced when sig.IntroducedIn (85 in IntrinsicCatalog) exceeds DialectLevel; at 85 MEDIAN is available and no diagnostic is raised

ConstructRegistry NumericFunctionIdentifierOperand2002: at 85 a numeric or integer function written outside an arithmetic expression is refused (COBOL0900, §1985:IV.4.3.8.3.3 SR4); at 2023 it is accepted

reader.edition-search: grep for Edition|CobolVersion|DialectLevel in IntrinsicRenderer.cs, NumericRenderer.cs, IntrinsicArgumentRules.cs, IntrinsicCarrierRules.cs, FunctionValueLane.cs and IntrinsicCatalog.cs found none; IntrinsicBinder.cs hits are listed. The renderer's lane choice reads the arithmetic mode (num.StandardDecimal, from the OPTIONS paragraph), never the edition; at 85 there is no OPTIONS paragraph, so the native arm runs, the same arm a 2023 program without OPTIONS takes.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no for the ordering; yes at the reference site: 85 refuses a MEDIAN reference outside an arithmetic expression, 2023 accepts it
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf40_03 covers literals, a signed item and a fixed-size table with ALL; not covered: ODO-bounded ALL, mixed usages (PACKED-DECIMAL, BINARY), P-scaled items, -0, 17/18-digit extremes, arithmetic-expression arguments

reader.notes: MedianScaled sorts the scale-aligned unscaled Int128 values with Array.Sort, which is exactly the algebraic order the numeric simple condition requires; -0 and +0 align to the same value and tie. A list with an approximate operand rides MedianDec on the SDIDI carrier, also an exact compare. Every probe printed the same at --std 2023.
